name: Marcus Ellison
headline: Senior AI / ML Engineer

Skilled in building scalable ML pipelines, fine-tuning deep learning models, and integrating generative AI into production environments. Proven track record leading cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, high-performance AI solutions.

Architect and deploy scalable ML pipelines on AWS SageMaker and Kubernetes
Mentor junior engineers on model development best practices and code reviews
Collaborate with product teams to integrate generative AI features into customer-facing applications
Optimize inference latency for production-grade transformer models
Developed computer vision models for defect detection in manufacturing pipelines
Built and maintained ETL pipelines for training data preparation
Implemented model monitoring and retraining workflows to ensure production reliability
Worked with data scientists to translate research prototypes into deployable services
Built predictive models for customer churn and demand forecasting
Automated data preprocessing and feature engineering workflows
